chapters.title: Further Speaking Practice. Asking for/giving directions

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Asking for / giving directions, упр. 1, с. 81. Разыграй диалог по ролям.
steps: — Excuse me, where exactly is the animal hospital? — Go along Hill Street and turn left into New Road. It's opposite the garage. — Thanks!
problems.answer: — Excuse me, where's the animal hospital? — Go along Hill Street, turn left into New Road. It's opposite the garage. — Thanks!

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Asking for / giving directions, упр. 2, с. 82. В парах разыграйте похожие диалоги по картинке.
steps: — Excuse me, where exactly is Mr Baker's house? — Go along Hill Street and it's on your left, opposite the hotel. — Thanks! — Excuse me, where exactly is the hotel? — Go along Hill Street and it's on your right, opposite Mr Baker's house.
problems.answer: — Where exactly is Mr Baker's house? — Go along Hill Street, it's on your left, opposite the hotel. — Where's the hotel? — On your right, opposite Mr Baker's house.

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Giving information, упр. 1, с. 81. Разыграй диалог по ролям.
steps: Denis: Who's this? — Valentina: This is my uncle Danil. — Where does he live? — He lives in England. He's a doctor. — How old is he? — He's forty-five. — What's he like? — He's very kind and friendly!
problems.answer: — Who's this? — My uncle Danil. — Where does he live? — In England, he's a doctor. — How old is he? — 45. — What's he like? — Kind and friendly.

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Giving information, упр. 2, с. 81. В парах разыграйте похожие диалоги.
steps: — Who's this? — This is my aunt Galina. — Where does she live? — She lives in Moscow. She's a teacher. — How old is she? — She's forty. — What's she like? — She's very friendly!
— Who's this? — This is my cousin Victor. — Where does he live? — In Paris. He's a student. — How old is he? — Ten. — What's he like? — Very clever!
problems.answer: — Who's this? — My aunt Galina. — Where does she live? — In Moscow, she's a teacher. — How old is she? — 40. — What's she like? — Friendly.

steps: — Excuse me, can I have two bars of chocolate, a jar of jam and a tin of beans, please? — Yes, of course. Here you are. — How much is it? — Four pounds seven pence, please. — Here you are. — Thank you.
problems.answer: — Can I have two bars of chocolate, a jar of jam and a tin of beans, please? — Here you are. — How much is it? — Four pounds seven pence. — Here you are. — Thank you.

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Buying food, упр. 2, с. 82. В парах разыграйте похожие диалоги.
steps: — Excuse me, can I have a loaf of bread, a carton of milk and a packet of biscuits, please? — Yes, of course. Here you are. — How much is it? — That's two pounds ninety-four pence, please. — Here you are. — Thank you.
